events.text: I'll start with the requirement list, then check each item on disk.

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check env files, origin state, run T-263 probe
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; ls -la .env* cloud/.env* app/.env* cloud/.dev.vars 2>&1 | awk '{print $NF}'; for f in .env cloud/.env app/.env.local app/.env cloud/.dev.vars; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "$f: $(grep -c -i tantra "$f") tantra lines; keys: $(grep -i tantra "$f" | cut -d= -f1 | tr '\n' ' ')"; done; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; git status -sb | head -1; node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | tail -4

events.name: Bash
events.head: Count probe passes, look for Tantra key names, read sender check script
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | grep -cE '^PASS'; node cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs 2>&1 | grep -E '^FAIL' | head; ls ~/.config/tantra/keys/ 2>&1; for f in ~/.config/tantra/keys/* ~/tantra-redesign/cloud/.dev.vars ~/tantra-redesign/app/.env.local; do echo "$f: $(cut -d= -f1 "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'tantra|fintech' | tr '\n' ' ')"; done; ls ~/*/.env 2>/dev/null | head; sed -n 1,40p cloud/scripts/check-tantra-senders.mjs

events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate end-time, minutes, and sender gate code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud; grep -n "x-api-key\|X-API-KEY\|Authorization" src/connectors/tantra*.ts src/jobs-tantra.ts 2>/dev/null | head -4; grep -rn "eventEndWall\|lengthMinutes" src | grep -v "^\s*//" | head; grep -n "tantraSenderStatus" -r src | head; grep -n "start-calendar-ws" src/agentic.ts | head

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -n "x-api-key\|headers" cloud/src/connectors/s1.ts | head -3; sed -n 2008,2030p app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts; grep -n '"ev_length"\|id: "ev_length"' app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -3; grep -n "domain-wide\|Domain-wide\|reminder" app/src/lib/workshop-cards.ts | head -8; grep -nE "^\| (X014|X015|N009|N011|N012|N015|N018|N028) " /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/AUDIT.md | awk -F'|' '{print $2,$(NF-1)}'; grep -n "^import\|agentic\|fieldProblem\|eventEndWall" cloud/scripts/probe-t263.mjs | head

events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; grep -rn "tantraHeaders\|tantraUrl" cloud/src --include=*.ts | grep -E "export (const|function)" ; f=$(grep -rln "export function tantraHeaders\|export const tantraHeaders" cloud/src app/src 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo $f; grep -n -A4 "tantraHeaders =\|function tantraHeaders\|function tantraUrl\|tantraUrl =" $f | cut -c1-200
